def transforms(shape):
 out=set()
 for k in range(4):
  for refl in (False,True):
   pts=[]
   for r,c in shape:
    if refl: c=-c
    for _ in range(k): r,c=c,-r
    pts.append((r,c))
   mr=min(r for r,c in pts); mc=min(c for r,c in pts)
   out.add(tuple(sorted((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts)))
 return out
shapes=transforms(mask)
[(s,max(r for r,c in s)+1,max(c for r,c in s)+1) for s in shapes]
